description: This file contains unit tests for the ModelCatalogLoader, specifically testing the parsing of model data from TypeScript source files. It uses test cases to verify correct parsing and handling of source files with model definitions.

methods.name: load parses models from type script and sorts
methods.description: Tests that the ModelCatalogLoader can correctly parse model data from a TypeScript source string, write it to a temporary file, and verify the parsed model choices and their attributes.

methods.name: load with no export returns empty choices
methods.description: Tests that when the source file does not contain valid export models, the loader returns an empty list.
